selected_evidence.summary: Shows the release-team group and /srv/releases as root:release-team with mode 2775 (drwxrwsr-x).

selected_evidence.requirement: New files inherit the workspace group
selected_evidence.summary: Pre- and post-reboot writes by a release-team process created mode-664 files owned by group release-team.

Captures the healthy baseline, acknowledged safe reboot, changed boot identity, running system with zero failed units, writable filesystem, persistent workspace configuration, and recovered inheritance behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'release_team_group='; getent group release-team || true
printf 'releases_path='; if [ -e /srv/releases ]; then stat -c '%F mode=%a owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /srv/releases; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf 'mount='; findmnt -T /srv 2>/dev/null || findmnt -T / || true
printf 'failed_units='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.72.10
boot_id=f54d7366-0403-4b05-93bb-b5c0a1818892
os=almalinux 9.6
release_team_group=releases_path=absent
mount=TARGET SOURCE    FSTYPE OPTIONS
/      /dev/vda4 xfs    rw,relatime,seclabel,attr2,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=32k,noquota
failed_units=

commands.command:
set -eu
if getent group release-team >/dev/null; then
  printf 'group_action=already-present\n'
else
  groupadd release-team
  printf 'group_action=created\n'
fi
getent group release-team

set -eu
install -d -o root -g release-team -m 2775 /srv/releases
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon -R /srv/releases; fi
stat -c 'type=%F mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /srv/releases
ls -Zd /srv/releases 2>/dev/null || true
commands.stdout:
type=directory mode=2775 symbolic=drwxrwsr-x owner=root group=release-team path=/srv/releases
system_u:object_r:var_t:s0 /srv/releases

commands.command:
set -eu
test_path=/srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
[ ! -e "$test_path" ]
runuser -u nobody -g release-team -- sh -c 'umask 002; printf test > /srv/releases/.[REDACTED]; id'
stat -c 'created_file mode=%a owner=%U group=%G path=%n size=%s' "$test_path"
[ "$(stat -c %G "$test_path")" = release-team ]
rm -f -- "$test_path"
[ ! -e "$test_path" ]
printf 'inheritance_check=passed cleanup=passed\n'
commands.stdout:
uid=65534(nobody) gid=1000(release-team) groups=1000(release-team) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0
created_file mode=664 owner=nobody group=release-team path=/srv/releases/.[REDACTED] size=4
inheritance_check=passed cleanup=passed
